object_context: Let f:X→S be a smooth projective family of complex varieties, s0∈S, and α a flat rational cohomology class that is algebraic on X_s0 via one fixed finite signed rational witness z0. Fix an irreducible local Hodge-locus branch T through s0. H4d1b asks, only at first order and only for this chosen witness/category, whether the branch-relative witness obstruction map δ1 vanishes on T_s0 T without assuming the desired lift or full semiregularity. Initial algebraicity, higher Artin lifting, algebraization, monodromy and global continuation are outside this atom.
structural_coordinates: exact scope is rational cohomology on smooth projective complex varieties; central witness already exists
chosen witness is a finite signed rational cycle with coefficient vector preserved after denominator clearing
π:W_α→S (or →T after base restriction) denotes a chosen witness-incidence/flag-Hilbert/Chow deformation space near z0
δ1 is the standard first-order obstruction/connecting map attached to the chosen witness deformation problem; its exact domain/codomain must remain source/category bound
T_s0 T is the tangent space of one fixed local Hodge-locus branch; singular/nonreduced scheme structure can make tangent information weaker than local equality
geometric witness deformation preserves the flat cohomology class and therefore gives a base direction where α remains Hodge
first-order tangent lifting is distinct from compatible higher-order formal lifting, algebraization and branch domination
alternative detectors or obstruction objects are separate representations and may not silently inherit H4d1b conclusions
equivalent_formulations: every first-order Hodge-branch direction lies in the kernel of the chosen witness obstruction map
for the standard incidence deformation sequence, test whether T_s0 T is contained in im(dπ_(z0,s0))
if im(dπ) is automatically contained in T_s0 T, test whether first-order geometric and Hodge tangent directions coincide for the chosen witness branch
solved_analogues: codimension-one divisor/Picard variation, where Lefschetz (1,1) and line-bundle deformation give a strong positive control
semiregular codimension-one maps/cycles in Nishinou's relative deformation setting, where Hodge persistence controls the source-bound obstruction
Kloosterman's complete-intersection cycles on hypersurfaces, where flag-Hilbert geometry and Hodge-locus tangent/dimension information prove a variational Hodge result in that special family
near_solved_analogues: semiregularity/reduced-obstruction theories of Buchweitz–Flenner and Pridham
formal cycle-class deformation mechanisms of Bloch–Esnault–Kerz under additional structure

explicit_disanalogies: The root rational Hodge conjecture asks initial algebraicity for any rational Hodge class; H4d1b starts with an already algebraic central witness.
A signed rational witness requires coefficient-preserving multi-component bookkeeping; one effective Hilbert component is insufficient in general.
The tangent space of an irreducible Hodge-locus branch can fail to control nonreduced or higher-order structure.
A first-order equality cannot substitute for higher Artin lifting, formal compatibility, algebraization, monodromy or global continuation.
Kloosterman/Nishinou are special source categories and cannot be generalized by analogy alone.
analogy_scan_notes: Cross-domain/local-to-global and lifting analogies were reviewed but rejected for certification because they do not preserve the exact algebraic-cycle deformation category, rational coefficients, Hodge tangent condition, or higher-order obstruction structure. The active transfer is mathematical and source-bound.
